sents.en: I put on my favorite sweater.
My sweater is orange.
My stepmom waits for me to get my bike and helmet.
sents.ko: 새엄마가 제가 자전거와 헬멧을 가져오길 기다려요.

sents.en: My helmet is orange.
We ride under the fall leaves.
sents.ko: 우리는 가을 잎 아래로 자전거를 타요.

sents.en: Many of the leaves are orange.
At the pumpkin patch, I find the best pumpkin.
sents.ko: 호박밭에서 저는 가장 좋은 호박을 찾아요.

sents.en: The pumpkin is orange.
My stepmom buys some flowers.
The flowers are orange.
We see a striped cat as we ride home.
sents.ko: 집으로 가는 길에 줄무늬 고양이를 봐요.

sents.en: The cat's stripes are orange.
I wave to the scarecrow in our yard.
The scarecrow's vest is orange.
My stepmom and I have oranges for a snack.
The slices are orange.
A bird watches us from the tree.
sents.ko: 새 한 마리가 나무에서 우리를 봐요.

sents.en: The bird's belly is orange.
We all watch the sunset.
The sunset is orange.
Wow! The color orange is so beautiful, especially orange flowers.
sents.ko: 와! 주황색은 정말 예뻐요. 특히 주황색 꽃이요.

sents.en: What else can you think of that has the orange color?
Orange trees, orange pumpkins…
Tell me more about it later.
I'll see you next time. Good-bye for now.
